title: Business days land on Saturday
report: Due dates computed with add_business_days sometimes land on a Saturday.

title: Threshold discount missing
report: A customer with a subtotal of exactly 5000 did not get the 5% volume discount.

title: Rounding 2.675
report: to_money('2.675') returns 2.67, but we always round half up, so it should be 2.68.

title: CSV header with spaces
report: Importing a CSV whose header has spaces after the commas fails with 'missing columns'.

title: Overdue on due date
report: Invoices are flagged overdue on their due date; they should only be overdue from the next day.

title: GST halves don't add up
report: For odd amounts like 18.01, CGST + SGST no longer add up to the tax.

title: Split gives extra cents to the end
report: split_evenly gives the leftover paise to the last parts; the spec says earlier parts get them.

title: Coupon with spaces ignored
report: A coupon pasted as ' welcome ' (with spaces) is not applied.

title: Tax too high on discounted invoices
report: Tax on discounted invoices is too high. Tax should be charged on the amount after discount.

title: EOM due date wrong
report: Invoices with EOM terms get a due date in the previous month.

title: Capitalised category crashes
report: A CSV line with category 'Reduced' later crashes the tax calculation with KeyError.

title: Negative amounts print two minus signs
report: format_money(Decimal('-12'), 'USD') prints '-USD -12.00'.

title: Typo categories become tax-free
report: A line with a misspelled tax category is silently charged zero tax instead of raising an error.

title: Big orders get the small discount
report: Orders above 10000 only get 5% volume discount instead of 10%.

title: CSV import crashes in decimal
report: Importing our CSV crashes with a decimal InvalidOperation. Maybe the quantity column is being parsed wrong?

title: GST split off by a paisa
report: The intrastate GST split is off by one paisa for some amounts.

title: One business day after Friday is Tuesday
report: add_business_days(friday, 1) returns Tuesday instead of Monday.

title: Empty draft invoices crash
report: Computing the total of an empty draft invoice raises an error.

title: Every CSV import fails
report: Every CSV import fails with 'missing columns' even though the files look fine.

title: Totals too high since last release
report: Invoice totals have been too high since the last release. The tax module must be overcharging.
